chunks: I found in the Nawādir of Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: No, by Allah! Allah did not delegate to anyone among His creation except to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and to the Imams.
He, Mighty and Majestic, said: “Indeed We sent down to you the Book with the truth so that you may judge between the people by what Allah has shown you.”
And it continues to apply among the successors عليهم السلام.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams عليهم السلام who share in this divinely granted authority
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the designated successors who continue this authority
key_terms.الْكِتَابَ: the revealed Book sent down with truth
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as the primary recipient of divine authority
key_terms.لِتَحْكُمَ: so that you may judge between people

ai.seo_question: To whom did Allah delegate authority to judge and govern in religion?
ai.summary: This hadith states that divine delegation of authority was granted only to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and to the Imams عليهم السلام. It cites the Qur’anic verse about judging by what Allah has shown and affirms, in Shia understanding, that this authority continues in the awṣiyāʾ.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan who said, ‘I found in the miscellaneous (Ahadeeth reported by) Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Authorised to anyone from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures except to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and to the Imams<sup>asws</sup>.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [4:105] Surely We have Revealed the Book to you with the Truth that you may judge between people by means of that which Allah has Shown you
, and it flows among the successors<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan who has said the following. “I found in the Nawadir (works) of Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan who has said that abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said the following. “
No, I swear by Allah, that He has no made anyone of His creatures the in charge except the Messenger of Allah and the Imams (a.s.).
Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, “ We have sent down to you the Book with the truth, so that you may judge between the people by that which Allah has shown you [4:105]
and it is continued to be valid and in full force with the executors of his will.”
